infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: FamilyOS connects to your development computer on your home Wi-Fi when you choose a local test server.

plugins.photosPermission: FamilyOS lets you choose family photos for the TV and photos of finished chores.
plugins.cameraPermission: FamilyOS uses the camera when you photograph a finished chore or a flyer to import.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FamilyOS uses your approximate location once to show local weather on your family TV.
